title: Q-CLONE-status-page-before-deploy: A copied template shows its status on a page before it has a place to run
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** cmd:cd seed && python3 -m unittest tests.test_happy_path
**Status:** open

CLONE-PATH-1 tells the person what happened on one issue thread in their copy (seed/bootstrap/intake.py `tell`). A person who has never used GitHub still has to find that thread. Publish org/owner-status.json as a plain page through the repository's own Pages (GitHub's built-in credential, no sign-in) and put its address in the repository description, so the first screen they see says where the system is.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:cd seed && python3 -m unittest tests.test_happy_path ; cd seed && python3 -m unittest tests.test_happy_path

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`; this item closing by its done check keeps the share of well-specified open items at or above today's reading)

**Out of scope:** changing what a visitor is asked, adding a step a person performs, or naming a key on any card.
